nodes.description: External function createClone(address target) returns (address result) that deploys a minimal proxy clone using assembly.
Assembly block using create(0, clone, 0x37) to deploy a minimal proxy clone; low-level EVM create operation.
address target parameter of createClone; address of implementation to clone.
bytes20 targetBytes = bytes20(target); local variable holding target address bytes.
Memory pointer clone = mload(0x40); local variable used to build minimal proxy bytecode.
Named return address result; receives address returned by the assembly create op.

edges.reason: Function createClone executes the assembly create operation in its body.

Local variable targetBytes is embedded into the clone bytecode consumed by the assembly create operation.
Local variable clone provides the memory pointer for bytecode passed to the assembly create operation.
The assembly create operation returns the new clone address, assigned to local variable result.
Function createClone returns the local variable result.
